summary: GSK plc filed a Form 6-K, the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer's current report, disclosing a routine PDMR transaction notification under UK/EU market abuse rules. President, US Maya Martinez-Davis acquired 9.837 notional American Depositary Shares at $48.54 on 2026-09-08 within her GSK Executive Supplemental Savings Plan account on the NYSE, a single small transaction with no aggregated volume. No board recommendation, advisor, stake change, or structural or regulatory mechanics are implicated. This is an ordinary insider dealing disclosure, not a special situation; no deal terms apply and no risk-arb angle arises.
